subject: Controlled conveyance checkpoints — evaluation kit transfer & usage constraints
messages:
From: Jane Park <jane.park@retailco.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Rivera <mike@retailco.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exchange plan + initial MAP milestone ask

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — RetailCo is excited to run an initial evaluation. Before we spin up the sandbox, can you confirm the steps and constraints for exchanging our testcases and sample prompt pack? High-level ask below:  

1) A mutually agreed MAP with milestone dates for delivery, acceptance window, and takedown.
2) A short list of permissible uses (no production, no re-sharing, retention windows).
3) A named point of contact for access and an audit log export cadence.

We attached our internal MPA template and a small sample of the probe suite to the note. Looking for a quick plan we can sign off on by EOD Tuesday.

Thanks — Jane

Attachments: retailco_mpa_v1.pdf, probe-suite-index.csv

--
Jane Park
Director, AI Initiatives | RetailCo
jane.park@retailco.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@retailco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Exchange plan + initial MAP milestone ask

Hi Jane — appreciate the note and the draft MPA. Short answer: we can do the exchange under a short MAP + constrained usage annex. Proposed quick plan:  

- Day 0 (Nov 23): Redwood provisions ephemeral sandbox and issues one-time credentials to RetailCo POCs; promptpack sample hosted in gated bucket.
- Day 2 (Nov 25): RetailCo uploads probe-suite samples (we mirror, checksum, and queue for QA).
- Day 4–10 (Nov 27–Dec 3): Acceptance window; RetailCo runs evaluation, Redwood monitors token usage and provides weekly token-level export.
- Day 30 (Dec 23): Takedown + evidence of deletion; Redwood will provide an audit log and a storage snapshot for reconciliation.

Permitted uses (high level): evaluation only; no production inference; no redistribution; retention limited to 30 days post-acceptance unless otherwise agreed. We'll add encryption-at-rest and KMS key metadata to the annex.  

I've looped in Ben for operational ops and to confirm credentialing cadence. We'll produce a short MAP appendix you can sign electronically; can you confirm RetailCo's legal review timeline?

Priya

Attachments referenced: sample-promptpack-README.txt

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@retailco.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Operational checklist & MFA for one-time access

Hey Jane — quick operational notes:  

- We'll create a scoped API key tied to RetailCo's MAP deal id (RC-2026-1198). Key scope: read/write to sandbox only; TTL = 72 hours after first use.
- Access will require hardware-backed MFA for RetailCo POCs; we can accept FIDO2 tokens or YubiKey.
- We'll emit daily audit logs to the S3 URL in the MAP appendix; logs include token-level breakdown, request IDs, and model variant used.

Operational checklist I need from you by EOD Monday to proceed:  
- Confirm 2 POCs and their email addresses
- Confirm desired acceptance window dates (if you want to adjust)
- Provide the name of RetailCo's signer for the MAP appendix

If Legal needs to redline, Jordan is standing by to ingest minimal changes. Happy to run the initial provisioning on Tuesday morning.

Best — Ben

Attachment: probe-suite-index.csv

From: RetailCo Legal <contracts@retailco.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Park <jane.park@retailco.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:14:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Exchange plan + initial MAP milestone ask -- redlines

On Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:14:00 -0800 RetailCo Legal wrote:

Priya — see inline redlines on the MAP appendix we prefer:  

- Retention: request 45 days (instead of 30) for internal reconciliation.
- Use: allow limited model fine-tuning for evaluation if data is synthetic or RetailCo-owned PII redacted; Redwood must approve fine-tune config.
- Audit evidence: require weekly signed attestations during the acceptance window.

Please confirm if Redwood can accept those three items as part of a limited-scope amendment (we don't want a full contract negotiation). We're attaching a short PDF with the redline highlights.

Regards,
RetailCo Legal
contracts@retailco.com

Attachments: retailco_mpa_v1_redline.pdf

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: RetailCo Legal <contracts@retailco.com>, Jane Park <jane@retailco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Exchange plan + initial MAP milestone ask -- redlines

Thanks — quick responses inline:  

- Retention: we can extend to 45 days for this pilot only; we'll reflect in the appendix and add a per-account audit field.
- Limited fine-tuning: Redwood will permit evaluation-only tuning provided RetailCo confirms data provenance and any PII is removed; Redwood approves training config in writing; any persistent model artifacts remain with RetailCo and are covered by the same usage constraints.
- Weekly attestations: we can provide signed weekly attestations for the acceptance window.

Next steps (action items):  
- Jordan to merge redline into MAP appendix and send DocuSign by EOD Wednesday.
- Jane to confirm two POCs (email + FIDO method) by EOD Wednesday.
- Ben to prepare one-time scoped key and provisioning runbook on Tues (Nov 25).

If we get the signatures by Thursday morning, provisioning can start Thursday afternoon and acceptance window remains Nov 27–Dec 3. If that timeline slips, we'll push to the first week of December.

Priya Natarajan
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0199
